heavyWeaponSemanticPolicy.hybridRule: Hybrid items receive conditional heavy_weapon relevance only in Heavy Weapons modes.
heavyWeaponSemanticPolicy.ammunitionRule: Heavy Weapon ammunition may carry heavy_weapon relevance when use is resolved through a Heavy Weapon launcher.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: 3d12 single-fire area cannon; 10 shots; full/half primary-target resolution plus half damage to adjacent targets on a hit.

source.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Native 3d10 stun; 20-shot carbonite cartridge; a target moved down the condition track is also immobilized until the end of its next turn.
Tripod single-shot 2x2 area missile launcher; normally crew-reloaded as a move action; two swift actions can improve effective range one step; max one shot per round.
3d12 autofire-only generator-powered tripod weapon; normally requires a second crew member to regulate power or attacks take -2.
Grenade-launcher ammunition affecting a 2x2 area; hits deal 3d8 stun and grab; trapped targets take recurring 3d8 stun each round.
unrepresentedMechanics: This identity is ammunition, not a standalone launcher; delivery/range are inherited from the grenade launcher.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: 5d6 fire cone 12 squares long and 8 wide at the end; 20-use tank; full-round reload; tripod reduces effective wielding size.
Four-round payload launcher; loaded grenade determines damage/type/burst/effects; full-round reload; rifle-mountable in 1 minute with DC 15 Mechanics; cannot fire thermal detonators.
assignments.recommendationFit: Payload-flexible launcher; semantics should inherit from the loaded grenade.
unrepresentedMechanics: Loaded grenade supplies damage, area, stun/ion/control and other payload semantics dynamically.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Huge Inaccurate 4d12 area cannon; 10 shots; Medium or smaller wielder must spend two swift actions immediately before firing to brace it; no Long range.
assignments.recommendationFit: Maximum cannon damage with a setup tax.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: 3d10 autofire-only; 20-shot pack or generator; cannot brace unless mounted on tripod or another mount.
DC-17m switches among rifle, sniper, and anti-armor modes. Only anti-armor mode uses Heavy Weapons proficiency and fires a 4d6 3-square-burst round.

selectorGuardrails: Preserve Phase 4D global tags; resolve Heavy Weapon applicability against active anti-armor mode only.

assignments.recommendationFit: Hybrid rifle/heavy platform; Heavy Weapon relevance is conditional on anti-armor mode.

conditionalSemanticTags.reason: Only the anti-armor profile uses Heavy Weapons proficiency.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Single-shot antivehicle launcher firing one light concussion missile per attack. The missile deals 4d10x2 slashing damage with a 2-square splash. Attacks against targets smaller than Huge take -10, and Rapid Shot cannot be used.

explicitAbilityLinks.effect: Rapid Shot cannot be used with this launcher.

selectorGuardrails: Payload damage/type/splash are missile-owned; launcher owns delivery restrictions.
Do not convert the -10 against smaller targets into a generic accuracy semantic tag.

assignments.recommendationFit: Dedicated anti-vehicle launcher for Huge targets and larger battlefield threats.

rationale.heavy_weapon: The attack profile uses Heavy Weapons proficiency.
rationale.ranged: It is a ranged missile launcher.
rationale.offense_ranged: It deals direct ranged missile damage.
rationale.burst_damage: The missile has a 2-square splash and very high payload damage.
rationale.vehicle: The source explicitly identifies it as antivehicle and mechanically penalizes attacks against targets smaller than Huge.

relativeToBlasterCannon.recommendationFit: Dedicated anti-vehicle launcher for Huge targets and larger battlefield threats; poor for infantry and multi-shot builds.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: -10 attack against targets smaller than Huge.
unrepresentedMechanics.note: Vehicle semantics capture the role; exact size penalty remains structured.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: Launcher capacity/reload action are not stated by the source.
unrepresentedMechanics.note: Do not infer capacity from other missile launchers.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Six-shot portable missile launcher firing 8d6 energy 3-square-burst missiles. Direct, heat-seeking, and gravity-activated modes allow specialized target-category handling; the specialized modes impose -2 Reflex Defense on the selected target type. Reloading is a full-round action. A microrepulsorlift removes the launcher's weight from encumbrance while it is the active drawn weapon.

selectorGuardrails: Target-category modes do not make the launcher permanently droid-, vehicle-, or character-specific.

assignments.recommendationFit: Portable guided-area launcher with target-category assistance.

rationale.heavy_weapon: All launcher attacks use Heavy Weapons proficiency.
rationale.ranged: It is a ranged missile launcher.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its missile payload provides direct ranged damage.
rationale.targeting: Heat-seeking/gravity-activated modes mechanically improve attacks against a selected target category by reducing its Reflex Defense.
rationale.mobility: The built-in microrepulsorlift removes the weapon's weight from encumbrance while actively carried.

relativeToBlasterCannon.recommendationFit: Portable guided-area launcher for characters who need strong burst damage and target-category assistance without accepting normal heavy-weapon encumbrance.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: While active and drawn, the weapon's weight does not count toward encumbrance.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Four-shot proton torpedo launcher. Area mode fires a 6d10 2-square blast. A swift action switches to single-target mode, removing the area and changing damage to 6d10x2 with -10 against targets smaller than Huge. After every shot the launcher must be reset with a standard action.
assignments.recommendationFit: High-output anti-vehicle launcher with a heavy action-economy cost.

rationale.heavy_weapon: Both firing modes use Heavy Weapons proficiency.
rationale.ranged: It is a ranged torpedo launcher.
rationale.offense_ranged: Both profiles deal direct ranged energy damage.
rationale.burst_damage: Area mode produces a 2-square blast; focused mode doubles payload damage.
rationale.vehicle: Focused mode strongly favors Huge or larger targets through its -10 penalty against smaller targets.
rationale.swift_action: Switching into focused single-target mode is a swift action.
rationale.standard_action: The launcher must be reset with a standard action after each shot.
rationale.action_economy: Mode switching and mandatory post-shot reset are central to how the launcher operates.

relativeToBlasterCannon.recommendationFit: High-output anti-vehicle launcher that can choose area or focused damage, but pays one of the category's heaviest action-economy costs.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: Standard-action reset required after every shot.
Focused mode removes area, doubles payload damage, and imposes -10 against targets smaller than Huge.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Four-shot launcher firing standard 6d6 slashing missiles in a 2-square burst. One attack roll is compared against every target in the burst; hits deal full damage and misses half, with Evasion modifying the result. Reloading a four-missile magazine is a full-round action.

rationale.ranged: It is a ranged missile launcher.
rationale.offense_ranged: Loaded standard missiles deal direct ranged damage.
rationale.burst_damage: The standard missile produces a 2-square burst.

relativeToBlasterCannon.recommendationFit: Core general-purpose missile launcher: stronger burst radius than the Blaster Cannon but lower capacity and a full-round reload.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Large single-fire indirect launcher with a five-shell magazine. It cannot attack at point-blank range. For line of sight and cover, the attack's point of origin can be treated as 20 squares in the air. Mortar shells are statistically identical to grenades.

selectorGuardrails: Do not add forbidden `grenade` or `explosives` semantic tags.

assignments.recommendationFit: Indirect-fire weapon for attacking around terrain and conventional cover.

rationale.heavy_weapon: Its attack uses Heavy Weapons proficiency.
rationale.ranged: It is a ranged indirect-fire launcher.
rationale.offense_ranged: Its shells deal direct ranged explosive damage.
rationale.burst_damage: Mortar shells are area-effect grenade-equivalent attacks.
rationale.cover: Its elevated virtual origin directly changes cover calculations.
rationale.positioning: The 20-square-high line-of-sight origin lets the weapon attack around conventional battlefield geometry.

relativeToBlasterCannon.recommendationFit: Indirect-fire Heavy Weapon for attacking targets protected by terrain or conventional cover; poor at point-blank range.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: Line-of-sight and cover origin can be treated as 20 squares in the air.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Large 3d10 autofire-only cannon. If braced, its autofire area can expand from the normal 2x2 to 2x4. If not braced, attacks take an additional -5 penalty. It uses a 20-shot pack or can connect to a power generator.
assignments.recommendationFit: Wide-area sustained-fire cannon for braced firing lanes.

rationale.ranged: It is a ranged blaster cannon.
rationale.sustained_damage: Autofire is its only firing mode and generator support enables prolonged fire.
rationale.setup: Bracing materially improves the weapon and avoids an additional attack penalty.
rationale.burst_damage: When braced, it can cover an enlarged 2-by-4 autofire area.

relativeToBlasterCannon.recommendationFit: Wide-area sustained-fire cannon for characters willing to brace before attacking; especially strong when controlling a broad firing lane.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: Unbraced autofire takes an additional -5 attack penalty; braced autofire can expand to 2x4 squares.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Generator-powered Heavy Weapon affecting Huge or smaller targets. A grabbed object can be moved up to 10 squares in any direction or hurled at another target within 10 squares, dealing falling-object damage by size. It normally requires a second crew member to spend a standard action each round regulating power; otherwise attacks take -2. Tripod mounting makes it count as one size smaller.

selectorGuardrails: Crew regulation is a dependency, not an intrinsic teamwork semantic tag.
Do not tag telekinesis; this is technological tractor-beam control, not Force use.

assignments.recommendationFit: Heavy Weapon control platform for grabbing, moving, and hurling battlefield objects.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: Second crew member normally spends a standard action each round regulating power; otherwise attacks take -2.
Hurled object deals falling-object damage according to object size.
unrepresentedMechanics.note: Do not flatten this into a fixed damage formula.

rationale.heavy_weapon: Its tractor attack uses Heavy Weapons proficiency.
rationale.offense_ranged: The printed profile deals 3d6 and grabbed objects can be hurled for ranged impact damage.
rationale.grab: Its core function is seizing an object or target with the tractor beam.
rationale.control: It can hold and reposition grabbed targets or objects.
rationale.battlefield_control: Moving objects/targets up to 10 squares can radically alter battlefield state.
rationale.movement: The beam explicitly moves a grabbed object up to 10 squares.
rationale.positioning: Its primary tactical value is forced repositioning and object placement.

relativeToBlasterCannon.recommendationFit: Heavy Weapon control platform for moving, holding, and weaponizing battlefield objects rather than maximizing direct damage.
